author: Nate Miller
title: Matt Olson delivers another multi-homer game
desc: Matt Olson went 2-for-5 with a pair of homers and three RBI in Monday's 7-6 loss to the Mets.
impact: Olson crushed Mets' pitching over the last four days, turning in two multi-homer games while going 6-for-18 with five RBI and six runs scored overall. Olson now sports a stout .890 OPS with 24 deep drives and 57 RBI through 89 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Reynaldo Lopez turns in another terrific effort
desc: Reynaldo Lopez allowed one run on just three hits and two walks while striking out five over five innings in Monday's 7-6 loss to the Mets.
impact: Lopez was excellent again for the Braves on Monday, surrendering just a single run over five frames for the second consecutive start. The veteran righty was long gone by the time the bullpens decided this back-and-forth contest in the 10th inning. Over three starts since returning to the Atlanta rotation, Lopez has now posted a 2.08 ERA and 0.92 WHIP across 13 innings. He could be a real fantasy sleeper for the second half.

author: Nate Miller
title: Cristopher Sanchez blasted by Royals on Monday
desc: Cristopher Sanchez surrendered nine runs on 12 hits and one walk while striking out just one batter over 3 1/3 innings in Monday's 15-1 loss to the Royals.
impact: To say Sanchez just did not have it Monday afternoon would be a drastic understatement. The All-Star southpaw had pretty much the worst outing of his career, getting tagged for a career-high nine runs. He allowed three homers in this one after giving up just eight over his first 18 starts of the season. Sanchez will just simply try to put this clunker behind him and rebound against the Tigers this weekend.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Clayton Beeter sneaks out save as Nats outslug Astros 12-11
desc: Clayton Beeter struck out one batter over 1.1 scoreless frames to earn the save in Monday's 12-11 win over the Astros.
impact: After Monday's win, Beeter now has a 3.00 ERA and 1.22 WHIP with seven saves, four blown saves and four holds across 27 appearances. Beeter has pitched well as of late, posting a 1.59 ERA over his last seven appearances.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Miles Mikolas survives 7-run clunker in win
desc: Miles Mikolas allowed seven earned runs on nine hits and two walks while striking out three over six innings in Monday's 12-11 win over the Astros.
impact: After the outing, he owns a 5.78 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 3-7 record across 19 games. Mikolas was able to hang around and earn the win due to the high powered Nats' offense providing him plenty of support. He is currently slated to make his next appearance against the Yankees.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Nasim Nunez fuels Nats with three-hit, two-run day
desc: Nasim Nunez went 3-for-4 in a 12-11 win over the Astros with two runs scored and one stolen base.
impact: After Monday's win, Nunez is batting .239 with one home run, 28 RBI, 37 runs scored and 33 stolen bases across 85 games. Nunez continues to find ways on base and continues to run wild on opposing teams, ranking first in NL in stolen bases.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: CJAbrams clubs HR, drives in three in wild win
desc: CJ Abrams went 3-for-5 in a 12-11 win over the Astros with a home run, two runs scored, three RBI and a stolen base.
impact: After Monday's win, Abrams is batting .274 with 19 home runs, 64 RBI, 55 runs scored and 14 stolen bases across 88 games. Abrams currently ranks eighth in the NL in home runs and third in RBI, as he continues his strong 2026 season for the Nationals.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Curtis Mead goes off in Nationals' wild 12-11 win
desc: Curtis Mead went 3-for-5 in Monday's win over the Astros with a home run, a double, two runs scored and three RBI.
impact: After Monday's win over Houston, Mead is slashing .240/.333/.483 with 15 home runs, 42 RBI, and five stolen bases across 75 games. Mead is swinging a hot bat right now, registering 11 hits over his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: James Wood cashes in with slam and swipe in wild win
desc: James Wood went 1-for-2 in the 12-11 win over Houston with a home run, three runs scored, four RBI, three walks, and one stolen base.
impact: After Monday's win, Wood is slashing .268/.398/.541 on the year with 24 home runs, 60 RBI, 81 runs scored, and 14 stolen bases across 92 games. Wood is hitting .400 with four home runs and 11 RBI over his last seven games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Ryan Fernandez saddled with loss
desc: Ryan Fernandez took the loss against the Brewers, allowing two hits and three runs (two earned) while recording zero outs.
impact: After the loss, Fernandez has a 2.70 ERA, 1.35 WHIP, 13.5 K/9 and one hold through 11 appearances.

author: Chase Davis
title: Dustin May's stuff flashed, but the bullpen spoiled it
desc: Dustin May tossed 4.2 scoreless innings, allowing four hits and no walks while striking out seven on 81 pitches in Monday's 4-3 loss to the Brewers.
impact: May now owns a 4.55 ERA and 1.25 WHIP with a 5-6 record, 8.6 K/9 across 17 starts. He looked good in his limited action after leaving his last start early. He allowed six hard hits and picked up 12 whiffs on 81 pitches. He gets a date with the Braves to finish out his first half.

author: Ari Koslow
title: German Marquez to start Tuesday for Padres
desc: German Marquez will start for the Padres on Tuesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Marquez threw 56 pitches over three innings in his first game back from the All-Star break last week. He'll remain off the fantasy radar as he likely remains on a pitch count.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval expected to start Thursday
desc: Patrick Sandoval is expected to make his season debut for the Red Sox on Thursday against the White Sox.
impact: Sandoval was activated from the 60-day injured list on Monday. He'll likely be a player to wait-and-see on for fantasy managers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Buehler struggles again Monday
desc: Walker Buehler allowed seven runs on seven hits over five innings with four strikeouts and one walk in a loss on Monday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Buehler allowed a pair of home runs, including a three-run shot to Max Kepler. He has allowed 16 runs over two starts to begin July. He'll look to close the first half strong against the Blue Jays.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Kepler drives in four runs Monday
desc: Max Kepler went 2-for-4 with a home run and four RBI in the Diamondbacks 8-0 win over the Padres on Monday.
impact: Kepler opened the scoring with an RBI single in the opening frame. He later added a three-run long ball. He'll continue to play in his platoon role moving forward.
